# Ross Ultrix OGP 1.0.1

Groups the routing action menu by Select Source, Select Destination, Take,
Group On/Off, Route, and Refresh Names. Existing saved action IDs, settings, and
protocol behavior are preserved.

Requires Hubble's `module-presentation-v1` capability, available in the public
Hubble 2.0.2 release. The runtime files are unchanged from 1.0.0. Grouped menus and
the module-only update were verified against a running Hubble host without a host
restart or changes to other module workers.

releases.notes:
# CCC 1.1.2

CCC now ignores unrelated or unchanged RCP camera status messages and publishes
workspace snapshots and connection status only when their values change. This
removes redundant background updates while preserving fresh recording reports
needed to confirm recording commands.

- Adds camera-specific selection feedback for Enable / Disable Camera, including
  when a selected camera or its RCP is offline.
- Keeps the CCC workspace module Ready when local camera selection is available;
  individual camera rows continue to report connection problems.
- Uses Enable / Disable Camera, Enable / Disable All Cameras, Start Recording,
  Stop Recording, and Toggle Recording as the action names. Existing action IDs,
  camera selections, and saved settings remain compatible.

## Qualification

- All 44 CCC tests across six files passed, including repeated recording reports,
  unchanged notification suppression, offline selection feedback, and recording
  coordination.
- TypeScript, module build, conformance, and packaging checks passed.
- The release archive rebuilds byte for byte from the reviewed source and matches
  the locally installed 1.1.2 package.
- Live service logs recorded 17 successful Stream Deck executions after the
  local update, with a median service execution time of 27 ms. Physical button
  display latency was not independently measured.
